text:
sam: FYI — prod-eu edge policy pushed ~10m ago. New egress tighten to audit-proxy is hitting rate limits, and we're seeing GPU node joins fail. Anyone on call?

ava: seeing `keystore-decrypt` 429s in node logs, manifests show `audit-proxy:443` errors.

mike: any recent firewall rules? who pushed the edge egress tighten?

jordan: sec team deployed a default-deny egress canary (FW-2102) in eu region, scheduled this morning. We hit an unexpected NAT QPS cap. Ping @security-bot

security-bot: Rolling update FW-2102 applied to eu-edge-* at 22:00Z. Rule denies outbound to non-privatenet telemetry endpoints unless allowlisted; intended to force audit-shipper to use privatenet.

ava: quick excerpt from the node logs -> correlated spike at 22:03 with GPU warmup failures (~50 nodes):
```
2026-03-23T22:04:01Z keystore: decrypt failed status=429, body="rate limit exceeded"
```

sam: Impact: GPUs stuck in Pending; warm pool keeps retrying and incurring cost. Rough estimate ~120 idle vGPU-min/hr while nodes retry.

mike: short-term options: add exception for audit-proxy in the FW, or increase NAT throughput/QPS?

jordan: security is wary of blanket exceptions. Proposed short plan: 1) temporary allowlist audit-proxy IPs for 30m; 2) enable backoff on keystore client; 3) route audit-export via privatenet where possible.

ava: I can flip allowlist now, but need approval. Sam, can you open a quick PR for the firewall exception and tag @jordan?

sam: PR created: `infra/fw/allowlist-audit-proxy-eu` — https://git.company/infra/pulls/1234. Requesting review from @jordan @mike.

mike: approving but also request a short-term quota bump on audit-proxy. Pinging ops-runbook. @sre-bot runbook-run (playbook: audit-proxy-qps-increase)

sre-bot: runbook executed: increased audit-proxy worker pool by +2 (ttl 45m). Watching metrics for 5m.

security-bot: Temporary allowlist approved until 22:50Z. Please ensure exception removed after TTL. Schedule postmortem and include cost delta in the summary.

sam: Rolling warm-pool restart now to force retries with new path.

ava: Node joins recovering; keystore 429s dropping. Will monitor backfill for audit logs to SIEM.

mike: Follow-ups: open ticket to add SIEM retention/backfill check and an autoscale policy for audit-proxy to avoid manual ops.

jordan: Also add a canary step to fw rollouts: target 1% of edge pods before global push.

sam: Thanks team — I'll file an incident summary, estimate cost impact, and own the rollback reminder to remove the allowlist.
